description: This file contains the implementation of the Session database storage class for OpenCart, handling session data read/write, destruction, and garbage collection.
external_files: DB (likely a database abstraction layer or class)

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A class responsible for managing session data stored in the database, including methods for reading, writing, destroying sessions, and garbage collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB session handler with Registry dependencies for database and configuration access.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database for a given session ID if it hasn't expired.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database for a given session ID with an expiration based on configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database for a specified session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to remove expired sessions based on probabilistic trigger.
